section_summary: This section comprises U.S. State Department correspondence, diplomatic notes, military permit action slips, and travel applications from May to July 1949 concerning travel to occupied Japan and Okinawa. Department officials coordinated with the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers (SCAP) and the Army's Pacific Military Permit Branch to process entry clearances for commercial buyers, missionaries, family visitors, and repatriates. Featured cases include foreign merchants from Thailand, Iran, Chile, and Syria, as well as stateless persons and family dependents requiring special documentation.
